notice: SIMULATED / illustrative. 人为构造；用于展示数据流，不构成药理、文献或安全性证据。

literature.zh: 示例文献卡：酯化可能改变脂溶性与释放过程，需要同时考察水解、暴露和制剂影响。此卡没有真实论文引用，不支持已验证 SAR。
literature.en: Illustrative literature card: esterification may alter lipophilicity and release. Hydrolysis, exposure and formulation require testing. No actual paper or validated SAR is claimed.

modifications.name: C17 side chain
modifications.zh: 考察侧链与代谢稳定性的关系；先做身份、纯度与同条件活性验证。
modifications.en: Probe side-chain and stability relationships; verify identity, purity and matched activity first.

modifications.name: C3 oxime
modifications.zh: 测试羰基替换假设；关注 E/Z 异构体与受体相互作用改变。
modifications.en: Test carbonyl replacement; assess E/Z isomers and altered receptor interactions.

modifications.name: Ester prodrug
modifications.zh: 比较酯化、水解与暴露；不能由 cLogP 直接推断吸收改善。
modifications.en: Compare esterification, hydrolysis and exposure; cLogP alone cannot establish absorption gains.

modifications.name: Fluorination
modifications.zh: 探索代谢位点假设；同时复核活性和安全性代价。
modifications.en: Explore a metabolic-site hypothesis while reviewing activity and safety tradeoffs.

modifications.name: Ring expansion
modifications.zh: 探索骨架几何变化；先核对可合成性和骨架识别边界。
modifications.en: Explore scaffold geometry; first review synthetic feasibility and scaffold constraints.

A.zh: 示例类似物剩余比例 46%，低于预设 50% 门槛；修改假设，补测活性与误差。
A.en: Illustrative analogue has 46% remaining, below the predefined 50% gate. Modify the hypothesis; measure activity and uncertainty.

B.zh: 仅补入一条示例试验记录，仍无完整重复与对照；继续补齐数据，不作活性排序。
B.en: One illustrative pilot record still lacks replicates and controls. Complete the data; do not rank activity.

C.zh: 示例候选暴露 180 ng·h/mL，低于预设 240 门槛；停止当前改造路线，复核水解与制剂因素。
C.en: Illustrative exposure is 180 ng·h/mL, below the predefined 240 gate. Stop this route and review hydrolysis and formulation.
